platt1999.note: No DOI. Read the author's preprint dated 26 March 1999 (pages rendered as images because the PDF text layer is font-encoded). The preprint footnote names the book (Advances in Large Margin Classifiers, eds. Smola, Bartlett, Schoelkopf, Schuurmans, MIT Press, 'to appear'). Pages 61-74 come from the reference list of niculescumizil2005 (fetched), not from the book itself. Kull et al. (2017) cite the book as 2000; the publication year is therefore uncertain (1999 vs 2000). Sections 2.2 (sigmoid fit by maximum likelihood, eq. 11-12) and p. 5 (training-set outputs are biased; use a hold-out set or cross-validation).

zadrozny2001.note: No DOI. Venue, year and pages (609-616) from the ML Anthology page https://mlanthology.org/icml/2001/zadrozny2001icml-obtaining/. Full text read from the author-hosted PDF: binning for naive Bayes, m-estimation and curtailment for C4.5 trees, on the single KDD'98 dataset.

zadrozny2002.note: Metadata from the Crossref record; abstract from OpenAlex. ACM page returned 403; no author-hosted full text found (cs.cornell.edu PDF is a course slide deck, not the paper). Isotonic-regression (PAV) calibration is attributed to this paper in the abstract ('a new method for obtaining calibrated two-class probability estimates that can be applied to any classifier that produces a ranking') and in niculescumizil2005 Sec. 2.2.

niculescumizil2005.note: Metadata from Crossref. Full text read from the authors' camera-ready PDF. Sec. 2 (independent calibration set), Table 2 (8 problems, 4000 train), Sec. 4 (qualitative: LR and bagged trees well calibrated; RF poorly calibrated on LETTER.P2 and not well calibrated on HS, COV_TYPE, MEDIS, LETTER.P1), Sec. 5 / Fig. 7 (Platt beats isotonic below about 200-1000 calibration cases; isotonic at least as good at >=1000), Sec. 6 / Fig. 8 (5 trials x 8 problems; 4k train, 1k calibration).

niculescumizil2005boosting.note: No DOI. arXiv record states 'Appears in Proceedings of UAI 2005' and journal-ref UAI-P-2005-PG-413-420. Full text read from the arXiv PDF: Table 2 (cross-entropy of boosted stumps and boosted trees, raw vs Platt vs isotonic vs logistic correction vs log-loss boosting, 8 problems); footnote 1 (predictions kept away from exactly 0 or 1 to avoid infinite cross-entropy).

caruana2006.note: Metadata from Crossref. Full text read from the author-hosted PDF: 10 learners, 11 binary problems, 5 trials of 4000 train / 1000 validation, the same 1000 cases used both to calibrate and to select parameters (Sec. 2-3); Table 2 and the results text on squared error and cross-entropy.

bostrom2008.note: Metadata (title, author, venue, pages 121-126) from OpenAlex for the DOI. Full text read from the author-hosted PDF: 34 UCI datasets, stratified 10-fold CV, out-of-bag examples as calibration sets, Brier score/AUC/accuracy; Sec. 3 results text and Table 1.

fonseca2017.note: arXiv preprint (no journal version found). Full text read from the arXiv PDF: Sec. 2.1 (18 consumer-credit datasets, chronological 60/20/20 train/calibration/test split, LR/RF/GBC x none/sigmoid/isotonic, Brier score only), Sec. 3 results text and Sec. 4 Discussion.

manokhin2026.note: arXiv preprint v1, 2026-01-19, 61 pages; not peer reviewed as far as the record shows. Full text read from the arXiv PDF: Sec. 1-3 (findings), Sec. 5.2 (21 classifiers incl. LR, RF, GBC, HGB; 30 binary TabArena-v0.1 datasets; 1x5-fold stratified CV with no repetitions; calibration set carved from the training folds; ECE with equal-mass monotonic-sweep bins), Sec. 2 text after Fig. 14-15 (aggregate relative changes in log-loss and Brier).

berta2026.note: arXiv preprint v2 (2026); arXiv comment says accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets track, not checked against the proceedings. Full text read from the arXiv PDF: Sec. 3 (TabRepo-binary: LR, RF, ExtraTrees, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost + 2 NNs, 104 binary datasets, 832 experiments, tuned on validation ROC-AUC), Sec. 5 (Post-Hoc Improvement in Brier score as main metric; binned ECE favours binning-based calibrators), Sec. 6.1 (binary results).

guo2017.note: No DOI. Metadata (authors, pages 1321-1330, PMLR 70) from the PMLR page. Full text read from arXiv:1706.04599v2: Sec. 2 (ECE definition with M equally spaced bins, citing Naeini et al. 2015; top-label confidence).

naeini2015.note: Metadata (incl. pages 2901-2907) and abstract from OpenAlex/Crossref. Full text not read. The attribution of the ECE acronym to this paper is from guo2017 Sec. 2 and roelofs2022 footnote 1 (both read in full).

kumar2019.note: No DOI. Metadata from the NeurIPS proceedings page. Full text read from arXiv:1909.10155v2: abstract and Sec. 1 (scaling methods are less calibrated than reported; binned estimates cannot measure the calibration error of continuous outputs; plug-in estimator vs debiased estimator).

nixon2019.note: Cited as the arXiv v2 (7 Aug 2020) that was read; author list (7 authors) from the arXiv record. The CVPR 2019 Workshops version (pp. 38-41, CVF open access) lists 5 authors (no Nguyen, no Liu); the Writer should cite the arXiv version. Abstract and Sec. 1 read.

roelofs2022.note: No DOI. Metadata (pages 4036-4054, PMLR 151) from the PMLR page. Full text read from arXiv:2012.08668v3: abstract (equal-mass bins have lower bias than equal-width; debiased estimator and ECE_sweep recommended) and Sec. 1.

kull2017.note: No DOI. Metadata (pages 623-631, PMLR 54) from the PMLR page. Full text read from the PMLR PDF: abstract and Sec. 1 (logistic calibration assumes normally distributed per-class scores; logistic family on scores does not contain the identity, so it can uncalibrate a calibrated classifier; isotonic prone to overfitting on smaller datasets).

brier1950.note: Metadata from the Crossref record for the DOI. Full text not read (AMS PDF link returned an HTML page). Cite only as the origin of the Brier score.

degroot1983.note: Metadata from Crossref and OpenAlex (OpenAlex gives pages 12-22; Crossref gives first page 12). Full text not read. Cite only as a standard reference for reliability diagrams/calibration of forecasters, as niculescumizil2005 does.

gneiting2007.note: Metadata from Crossref; abstract from OpenAlex. Full text not read.

dimitriadis2021.note: Metadata and abstract from Crossref/OpenAlex. Full text not read. Article number e2016191118 follows the PNAS DOI suffix convention; Crossref gives no page.

silvafilho2023.note: Metadata and abstract from Crossref/OpenAlex. Full text (open access) not read; cite only as a general survey.

pedregosa2011.note: No DOI. Metadata (16 authors, vol. 12, no. 85, pp. 2825-2830) and abstract from the JMLR page. Software citation for scikit-learn.
